attempts.sql: SELECT DISTINCT s.file_id AS file_path FROM code.symbols s JOIN code.files f ON f.file_id = s.file_id WHERE s.kind = 'module' AND s.line_start = 1 AND s.name = 'docstring' AND NOT f.is_test AND (s.summary IS NOT NULL OR s.summary_source IS NOT NULL)

request:
Which source files of the httpx library itself (test code excluded) start with a module-level docstring? Give the repository-relative file paths.

Requested output columns: file_path (string).
explanation: This query joins symbols to files and filters for module-level symbols at line 1 that have an associated docstring, excluding test files, returning distinct repository-relative file paths.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT s.file_id AS file_path FROM code.symbols s JOIN code.files f ON f.file_id = s.file_id WHERE s.kind = 'module' AND s.line_start = 1 AND s.name = 'docstring' AND NOT f.is_test AND (s.summary IS NOT NULL OR s.summary_source IS NOT NULL)
